name: @acorn/site
description: The public website at getacorn.dev: marketing pages and the docs, built as a static Astro and Starlight site.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @acorn/cli build && node scripts/reference.mjs && astro build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @acorn/cli build && node scripts/reference.mjs && astro dev
scripts.lint: node scripts/reference.mjs && astro check && tsc -p specimens
scripts.specimens: pnpm --filter @acorn/plugin-examples exec vitest run test/pictures.test.ts && vitest run && pnpm --filter @acorn/tui exec vitest run src/kit/specimens.test.tsx && pnpm --filter @acorn/extension exec vitest run src/sidebar/pictures.test.tsx
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs src/lib/*.test.ts src/worker.test.ts && vitest run scripts/referenceExamples.test.ts && node scripts/budget.mjs && playwright test
